basic_info.description: Experience the beauty of coastal living in this updated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home with panoramic water views spanning the hillsides of Marin, down the coast to Fort Funston. This single-family home is ideally located just a short distance from Ocean Beach and one block from the vibrant Taraval corridor, offering an array of popular restaurants and cafes. Bright and airy, the home features an exceptional indoor/outdoor living experience with a spacious walkout deck and a west-facing yard, perfect for enjoying stunning sunsets. Spacious eat-in kitchen is complete with new cabinetry, countertops, and hardware. Upper level's large bright bathroom features a skylight overhead, and a new vanity with quartz countertop. Additional room off lower bedroom makes a fabulous home office or play room.  The large garage provides parking for up to two cars, along with ample space for additional storage or a workshop.
